name: cd-proxy
description: Minimal Codex-only ChatGPT OAuth proxy with round-robin credential rotation.

scripts.start: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -p zig-out >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; bun run src/server.ts
scripts.check: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -p zig-out >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; bun run src/server.ts --check
scripts.test: bun run assert:native && zig build test && bun run zig:build && bun run scripts/test-native-auth.ts && bun run scripts/granular-round-robin-test.ts && bun run scripts/test-websocket-flow.ts && bun run scripts/test-cache-affinity.ts && bun run scripts/test-codex-websocket-cached.ts && bun run scripts/test-pi-coding-agent.ts
scripts.bench:request-response: bun run zig:build && bun run benchmarks/request-response.ts
scripts.bench:local-loop: bun run zig:build && bun run benchmarks/local-loop.ts
scripts.bench:all: bun run bench:request-response && bun run bench:local-loop
